thread:
Maya Patel: Quick announcement: we're merging Capacity and Runtime into a single org called Platform Performance. Priya will be the VP sponsor and Ethan Zhou will be the Senior Eng Manager for the combined team starting 2025-04-14. The move consolidates ownership of batching, KV cache, autoscaling, and routing. Two backfills approved: Staff SRE (runtime infra) and Sr SW Eng (batching/compilation). Leah will publish reqs tomorrow and share interviewer rubrics. Please update team pages/org charts and join the AMA Tue 10:00.

Ethan Zhou: Appreciate the trust — happy to lead. I'll set up 1:1s with current owners next week.

Leah Kim: Posting reqs + initial interview loop by EOD tomorrow. Recruiting: please prioritize Staff SRE and Sr SW Eng.

Priya Natarajan: We want minimal disruption to SLAs. I'll circulate a rollout checklist and boundary doc by Friday COB.

people-ops-bot: Maya Patel added event "Platform Performance AMA" to calendar Tue 10:00-10:30  attendees: all@company

Diego Morales: Congrats team. Small ask: can we freeze any non-critical infra migrations for two sprints during the handoff?

Maya Patel: Good call. Freeze non-critical infra migrations for two sprints. If there's a blocker, raise it in the AMA.

Ethan Zhou: Can someone grant me access to Dedicated capacity dashboards and the SLO board? @eng-infra

Leah Kim: Recruiting note: expected hire window 6-8 weeks. If teams need faster hires, add comments to the req thread.

Maya Patel: Thanks — this should reduce operational friction and speed up model routing improvements. Ping me or Priya with questions.
